project_type: Bash-based AWS GPU benchmark harness for DeepSeek-V4-Flash inference (SGLang) on EC2 spot, plus Markdown test-plan/report deliverables. README.md (Chinese) is the authoritative test plan.
language: Bash (scripts + stub-based test suite), some Python in infra/lambda/capacity_poller, Markdown reports
build_system: none (no compile step). Scripts are executed directly. Verification is tests/run-tests.sh plus bash -n syntax checks.
test_framework: tests/run-tests.sh - pure bash suite, no bats. Fake binaries in tests/stubs/ (aws, docker, curl, df, lsblk, mdadm, mkfs.xfs, mount, nvidia-smi, nvme, shutdown) are prepended to PATH and append every invocation to a call log; scripts under test run with DRY_RUN=1 and DRY_RUN_LOG=$STUB_LOG so irreversible actions are logged, not executed. Fixtures in tests/fixtures/ (run-20260807-150955-a1b2, variant-low-accept). Baseline: 22 cases / 220 assertions, all passing - must stay green.
build_command: bash -n on every modified script (no compile step exists)
verification_instructions: 1) bash -n on each modified/added script. 2) tests/run-tests.sh - all cases must pass, count must not regress below 22 cases / 220 assertions. 3) For live GPU work, verification is the presence of real bench_serving JSON in S3 under s3://tpot-bench-results-077090643075-us-west-2/runs/b300-matrix-20260809/<config>/ AND the mirrored copy in the repo, with non-null median_tpot_ms / median_ttft_ms / output_throughput / accept_length. 4) shellcheck is used in the repo's style (scripts carry shellcheck disable comments) - run shellcheck if available, it is advisory not blocking.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/run-summaries/<RUN_ID>-summary.md is generated by scripts/summarize-run.sh --run-id X --region Y (it also flips summary_done in results/stage-ledger.json). results/stage-ledger.json is the run ledger appended by scripts/launch-bench-ec2.sh and scripts/run-staged.sh. reports/<name>/ folders are hand-written but must match the shape of reports/h200-tp4-eagle-20260809/ (README.md, bench_custom.json, bench_official.json, run_metadata.json).
setup_instructions: No local setup needed. AWS CLI is already authenticated for account 077090643075. All interaction with the live GPU box is via AWS Systems Manager: aws ssm send-command --region us-west-2 --instance-ids i-0d2500b8c91851a30 --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --parameters 'commands=[...]' then poll aws ssm get-command-invocation --command-id <id> --instance-id i-0d2500b8c91851a30 --region us-west-2.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET from the harness host. THE LIVE B300 BOX IS THE SCARCE RESOURCE: i-0d2500b8c91851a30, p6-b300.48xlarge (8x B300 288GB), us-west-2b, spot request sir-dzrfki2p, one-time, interruption behavior=terminate, ~$50/hr. NO SSH: security group tpot-bench-noingress-sg (sg-0e24f30107d9a84c3) has zero ingress rules and there is no key pair. SSM is the ONLY access path. SSM commands have hung before on 'curl -sv' and 'docker exec ps aux' - use short, non-interactive commands and always pass an explicit -m timeout to curl. Never run a foreground SSM command that lasts minutes: detach long jobs with setsid nohup ... </dev/null >log 2>&1 & and poll the log file. The box has been verified free of self-termination timers (/run/systemd/shutdown empty, no at jobs, bootstrap watchdog process already exited; the watchdogd seen is only the kernel hardware watchdog) - the sole remaining risk is spot interruption, so upload every artifact to S3 as soon as it exists rather than batching at the end.
contribution_requirements: Commit to branch harden-ec2-bench-runner. DO NOT push and DO NOT open a PR - the orchestrator does that after review. Commit messages in this repo are conventional-commit prefixed (feat:/fix:/chore:/docs:) with Chinese descriptions. Reports and README content are written in Chinese to match README.md and reports/h200-tp4-eagle-20260809/README.md. Never invent a measurement: if a value cannot be read from a real artifact, write it as 未评估 with the reason (this rule is stated explicitly in scripts/summarize-run.sh's header and must be honored in the B300 report too).
key_patterns: Hard-won B300/B200 knowledge that must NOT be rediscovered by burning GPU time: (1) --enable-dp-attention with --dp N in ONE unified process FAILS on B300 with 'AssertionError: short-circuiting allreduce will lead to hangs', leaving an HTTP shell alive with all GPUs at 0 MiB; the awslabs dsv4flash-b300-intra-3p1d sample gets dp by running FOUR INDEPENDENT engine processes each at tp=2 over NIXL, not one process with dp=2. (2) SGLang asserts tp_size % dp_size == 0. (3) p6-b200 is a dead end on this SGLang version: 4 attempts all hit 'AssertionError: Hidden size mismatch' in fused_moe_triton/.../fused_moe.py during CUDA graph capture; the FP8 repack sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 separately failed with 'ValueError: Downcasting not allowed'. Do not spend B300 time on B200 theories. (4) Working MoE path on H200 was --moe-runner-backend marlin (W4A16 for Hopper); working path on B300 so far is --moe-a2a-backend megamoe (DeepGEMM), same as awslabs. (5) Model weights are already on local NVMe at /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash (159.6 GB, 73 files, FP4 experts) - reuse them, never re-download. (6) Swapping config = docker rm -f sglang-server then a new docker run. (7) Cold start is 10-20 min, dominated by DeepGEMM JIT pre-compile then CUDA graph capture; the JIT cache lives inside the container and is destroyed by docker rm, so copy it out to /opt/dlami/nvme and bind-mount it on later runs to cut cold start. (8) scripts/collect-results.sh holds the ONLY key-normalization logic for bench_serving output (median_tpot_ms is P50, plus p95_tpot_ms / median_ttft_ms / output_throughput / accept_length) and bench_serving APPENDS JSONL to --output-file; reuse collect-results.sh rather than writing a second parser.
relevant_files: README.md (authoritative plan: section 6 test matrix, 6.1 exact bench commands, 12.7 updated matrix, 12.9 pass/fail table A1-A9, 12.1 acceptance, 12.2 LMSYS baseline, 0.1 Benchmark Reports index table to update)
scripts/recipes/b300-tp2-dp2-fp4-megamoe.env (KNOWN BROKEN: says tp=4 dp=2 --enable-dp-attention, which is failure mode 1 above; must be corrected to what actually works)
tests/run-tests.sh (22 cases / 220 assertions, must stay green)
tests/stubs/ (aws, docker, curl stubs available for testing new scripts)
directory_structure: scripts/ = harness entrypoints (launch-bench-ec2.sh, run-staged.sh, run-benchmark.sh, collect-results.sh, summarize-run.sh, compare-results.sh, mirror-checkpoint.sh, preflight.sh, poll-capacity.sh, poll-b300-h200.sh) plus scripts/bootstrap/bench-bootstrap.sh (user-data) and scripts/recipes/*.env (per-config env files). tests/ = bash suite + stubs + fixtures. reports/ = per-run deliverable folders. docs/ = RUNBOOK, postmortem, run-summaries/. results/ = stage-ledger.json, capacity-poll.log. infra/ = Lambda capacity poller. .agents/tasks/ = task state from prior delegations.

acceptance_criteria_from_readme: README 12.9: A1 TPOT P50 <= 4.5 ms (must), A2 TPOT P95 <= 6.0 ms (advisory), A3 TTFT P50 <= 1.7 s (must), A4 TTFT P95 <= 2.5 s (advisory), A5 E2E P50 <= 8.45 s (must), A6 whole-machine 8 GPUs (must), A7 EAGLE enabled with accept length >= 2.0 (must), A8 50 consecutive requests with no OOM/crash (must), A9 40K vs 4K TPOT delta < 15% (advisory). README 12.2 LMSYS reference: H200 Flash tp=4 EAGLE ~266 tok/s / TPOT ~3.76 ms on 30K prefix + OSL 4096 single batch.
